executive_summary: Static old/current forecast schema audit. Validation keywords are unchanged; description text differs. This is not a fresh runtime check.

differences.old: OPTIONAL declaration of the derivation behind the submitted distribution. The FILE forecast_rationale.md is REQUIRED — gate g1 checks the filesystem directly, next to forecast.parquet, so this sidecar key is a declaration only and its absence cannot fail a submission. The file is NEVER SCORED: no submission is ranked higher or lower because of it, and no scoring code may read its content. It exists because a submission that recalled its answer and one that derived it are indistinguishable as a set of draws. Read only as a review screen over the top of the leaderboard; a flag opens a human review and cannot by itself produce a DNF or move a score.
